2) Preferred billing cadence (monthly vs net-30 invoice)
3) Any procurement/legal contacts to include on next steps

Next steps: I'll send a short invoice-style proforma and a recommended pilot configuration (3-month pilot + 20% pilot credit). If that sounds good, I'll loop in Karthik from finance for final numbers.

Thanks,

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Subject: Proforma + tiered unit economics (pilot estimate)

Sara — attached is a short proforma (redwood-proforma-20271004.pdf) and an updated pricing calculator. Key highlights:

Pilot config (recommended):
- Duration: 3 months
- Banding: Tier 1: 0–50M tokens @ $1,050/1M; Tier 2: 50–200M @ $900/1M
- Pilot credit: 20% credit in month 1 (applied to token charges)
- Onboarding & integration (one-time): $8,000 (flat)

Example monthly math (using 45M tokens/month):
- Token charge pre-credit: (45 * $1,050/1M) = $47,250
- Pilot credit month 1: -$9,450
- Net month 1 token cost: $37,800
- Monthly recurring estimate (post-pilot): ~$40,500

Dedicated capacity note (if you want predictable latency): reserved pool estimate +$6,500/mo (depends on model selection), we included a Dedicated line on page 2 of the proforma.

Attachments: redwood-proforma-20271004.pdf, steph_pricing_calc.xlsx

If the target is $1,000/1M, we can align via a pilot discount or commit-based slab. Karthik — please confirm final list prices and whether we can extend a 10% pilot discount to land at $950/1M for first 3 months.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>

Stephanie — quick internal note on margins and approvals:

- If we land at $950/1M for the pilot (3 months), margin is ~28% after credits and onboarding; acceptable for pilot under our playbook.
- Approve up to $8k onboarding credit and 20% pilot credit without exec sign-off. Any additional structural discount (beyond 10% pilot price) needs approval from VP Sales.

Suggested next step: send DocuSign with the pilot SOW + 3-month commitment at $950/1M (include termination clause if SLA not met).

Karthik
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
